entries.original: **Shared warm-up state across bundle copies** — both lazy boundaries (pi-tui and the senpi engine barrel) keep their memoized state on `globalThis` under process-wide symbols, so warming any copy satisfies every copy.
entries.translated: **Shared warm-up state across bundle copies** — both lazy boundaries (pi-tui and the senpi engine barrel) keep their memoized state on `globalThis` under process-wide symbols, so warming any copy satisfies every copy.

entries.original: **The task bundle warms its own copy at registration** — keeping its dynamic import alive through minification.
entries.translated: **The task bundle warms its own copy at registration** — keeping its dynamic import alive through minification.

entries.original: **Render-fault containment** — task/DAG status widgets render from bare timers; a faulting frame now logs once and skips instead of killing your session. Ever again.
entries.translated: **Render-fault containment** — task/DAG status widgets render from bare timers; a faulting frame now logs once and skips instead of killing your session. Ever again.

entries.original: Plus artifact-level regression tests that inspect the *built bundles* so minification can never silently strand a lazy barrel again.
entries.translated: Plus artifact-level regression tests that inspect the *built bundles* so minification can never silently strand a lazy barrel again.

entries.original: Long sessions no longer stop compacting after ten successful compactions (the absolute cap is telemetry-only now; the failure circuit breaker still guards runaways).
entries.translated: Long sessions no longer stop compacting after ten successful compactions (the absolute cap is telemetry-only now; the failure circuit breaker still guards runaways).

entries.original: Todo snapshots no longer recursively retain full history (KB -> MB growth that refilled context right after compaction).
entries.translated: Todo snapshots no longer recursively retain full history (KB -> MB growth that refilled context right after compaction).

entries.original: A manual `/compact` with nothing to summarize no longer aborts an in-flight continuation.
entries.translated: A manual `/compact` with nothing to summarize no longer aborts an in-flight continuation.

entries.original: `bun i -g omo-ai@beta` no longer warns `incorrect peer dependency "@anthropic-ai/sdk@0.91.1"` — the SDK pin now satisfies claude-agent-sdk's `>=0.93.0` peer range (audited symbol-by-symbol, additive-only).
